description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RussianTeam" name="Russian team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IrishTeam" name="Irish team"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendSpecifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendRequirementsRussian" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Participant_RussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendRequirementsIrish" name="Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Participant_IrishTeam"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TeamsSplit" name="Distribute requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements to Russian team" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsRussian">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements to Irish team" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsIrish">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRussianParts" name="Receive parts from Russian team" messageRef="Msg_PartsRussian">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveIrishParts" name="Receive parts from Irish team" messageRef="Msg_PartsIrish">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble plane interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightSplit" name="Start test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Perform test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightJoin" name="Flight and protocol completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver plane to customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_M17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_M17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Gateway_TeamsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M2" sourceRef="Gateway_TeamsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M3" sourceRef="Gateway_TeamsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M4" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRussianParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M5" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Task_ReceiveIrishParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRussianParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveIrishParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M8" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M9" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_FlightSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M10" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M11" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M12" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M13" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M14" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M15" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M16" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M17" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Order airplane">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectBars" name="Select bars">

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectSeats" name="Select number of seats">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectColor" name="Select color">

    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectToiletWater" name="Select amount of water in toilets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to manufacturer" messageRef="Msg_Specifications">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed by customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Task_SelectBars"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SelectBars" targetRef="Task_SelectSeats"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_SelectSeats" targetRef="Task_SelectColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SelectColor" targetRef="Task_SelectToiletWater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_SelectToiletWater" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_CustomerConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
